page.layout: Front cover of a limp-to-boards leather binding with blind-tooled decoration and two brass clasps on the fore-edge. No printed text.
page.notes: Front board of a bound volume, not a leaf of text. Blind-tooled frame and central panel with floral and scroll ornament, raised bands on the spine, and two brass clasp fittings on the right edge. The tooling has no lettering. A small paper label is at the lower left of the spine; it is not legible and is probably a shelf mark, so it is left out. Stains and wear are visible throughout.
